title: Schedule of Servicing Fees: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Unpaid Installment Rate Schedule
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — starting rate for the late charge on an installment left unpaid past its grace period.**

**Schedule.** The rate starts at 3.5 percent when the contract shows at least 30 installments satisfied and no returned payment in the last 24 calendar months; it starts at 4.25 percent when the contract shows at least 18 installments satisfied and no more than one returned payment in the last 24 calendar months, where the first condition is not met; in every other case this schedule sets no starting rate and the rate starts at the product's late-charge percentage of the unpaid installment.

| Installments satisfied | Returned payments on the contract, last 24 calendar months | Starting rate |
|---|---|---|
| 30 or more | none | 3.5 percent |
| 30 or more | one | 4.25 percent |
| 18 to 29 | none or one | 4.25 percent |
| 18 or more | two or more | none from this schedule |
| fewer than 18 | any | none from this schedule |

**Records and counting.** Installments satisfied are the count on the contract record; returned payments are the returned payment entries on the contract's ledger, by their dates. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- 30 satisfied, no returned payment in 24 months: 3.5 percent; 29 satisfied and none: 4.25 percent.
- A returned payment dated the 8th of a month, viewed on the 8th of the month 24 months later: outside the last 24 calendar months; viewed on the 7th of that month: inside.
